Clicking “Install” sets up a clean Tibia UI without excess animations and messages, basic hotkeys (Basic, Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer, Druid, Monk sets), sidebar buttons and action bars (including spells and boat travel).

The settings apply to the whole account. Your login, sound, graphics and window position stay. Hotkey sets with the same names are replaced, others stay. Close Tibia before installing. The original file is copied with the ending “{suffix}”.
